issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

(I'm using Google Translate, sorry for any bad words)

### Input code

```typescript

import.meta.fn()
import.meta.c
```


### Config

```json
    }

  "module": {

  },
  "minify": false,
  "isModule": true
}
```
